properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Shipped dependency inventory: hash.js@1.1.7 (resolved at package-lock.json:13544) provides pure-JS SHA-1/SHA-224/256/384/512 (plus MD5/Keccak/RIPEMD160) implementations. Dependency of elliptic@6.5.4, i.e. it sits inside the secp256k1 signing path of this Ethereum dapp. SHA-1 exposure exists only as library surface; the app calls it only via elliptic internals.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Shipped dependency inventory: secp256k1@^4.0.1 and @types/secp256k1 are resolved packages in the root lockfile of this ethers ^5.7/web3 ^1.7.5 Ethereum dapp, installed under ethereum-cryptography. This is the ECDSA-over-secp256k1 signing library the Ethereum JS stack uses to sign every transaction. The dependency is changeable here; the curve is fixed by the EVM protocol, so PQ migration (ML-DSA via account abstraction) is an ecosystem-level move, not this repo's choice alone.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The evp_bytestokey npm package is in the dependency tree (dependency of crypto-browserify/browserify-cipher, pulled in by react-scripts' browser crypto shim). It implements OpenSSL's legacy EVP_BytesToKey single-round MD5 KDF, so the build ships a weak KDF implementation; it is the algorithm the crypto shim uses to derive cipher keys from passwords. Lockfile entry only — no application call site found; presence is what this inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The bcrypt-pbkdf npm package is a declared dependency in the lockfile (package entry plus three dependents' requirements). It implements OpenSSH's bcrypt_pbkdf (Blowfish-based PBKDF) used for encrypted SSH key files — typically pulled in via sshpk/http-signature in the react-scripts request chain. Lockfile presence only; no application call site found in this repo's own source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA capability of the node-forge@0.10.0 dependency (LIB-fe0eb9a4): key transport, not signing — a session key encrypted to a public RSA key today is readable once a CRQC exists. node-forge implements RSA encryption and signing with configurable key sizes. Lockfile/dependency presence only; no application call site found in this repo's own source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: The create-ecdh npm package is a declared dependency in the lockfile (package entry plus dependents' requirements, v4.0.0). It is crypto-browserify's ECDH component — the browser shim for Node's crypto.createECDH, pulled in by react-scripts' webpack tooling. It ships classical elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman over arbitrary named curves (secp256k1, prime256v1, etc.), retroactively breakable under Shor. Lockfile presence only; no application call site found in this repo's own source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 signature capability of the tweetnacl@0.14.5 dependency (nacl.sign) — same library object LIB-0469707e, this is its EdDSA facet: classical signature scheme retroactively breakable under Shor. Lockfile/dependency presence only; no application call site in this repo's own source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Shipped dependency inventory: elliptic@6.5.4 (resolved at package-lock.json:10495) is the ECDSA/ECDH implementation used by the Ethereum JS stack (ethereum-cryptography, secp256k1 wrappers). Its ECDSA-secp256k1 signatures are quantum-unsafe (Shor); migration is the same ecosystem-level deadline problem as the secp256k1 package itself.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 key-agreement capability of the tweetnacl@0.14.5 dependency (nacl.box / nacl.scalarMult) — same library object LIB-0469707e, this is its DH facet: classical key agreement, harvestable/retroactively breakable under Shor. Lockfile/dependency presence only; no application call site in this repo's own source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Shipped dependency inventory: keccak@^3.0.0 (native Keccak binding) and @ethersproject/keccak256@5.7.0 resolved in the root lockfile — Ethereum's Keccak-256 (pre-NIST-padded SHA-3) used for transaction hashes, address derivation and event topics across ethers/web3. Quantum-acceptable (Grover only), no migration pressure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Shipped dependency inventory: pbkdf2@^3.x (browserify), @types/pbkdf2 and @ethersproject/pbkdf2@5.7.0 resolved in the lockfile — the KDF used by ethers/web3 for Ethereum keystore (web3-secret-storage v3) wallet encryption and by the browser polyfill chain. Iteration counts are chosen by calling keystore code, not visible in the lockfile.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: All 9 sites are lockfile entries for the scrypt-js npm package (v3.0.1). scrypt-js implements the scrypt memory-hard KDF and is a dependency of ethers.js (used for keystroke derivation from BIP39 mnemonics) and web3 in this Ethereum dApp's dependency tree. Lockfile presence only; the application calls ethers, which reaches it.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES ships in this tree via THREE implementations: node-forge@0.10.0 (RSA/PKI/TLS tooling chain of react-scripts), browserify-aes@1.2.0 (crypto-browserify's cipher shim — AES-128/192/256 in CBC/CFB/CTR/GCM/OFB, reached by bundled code calling createCipheriv in the browser), and aes-js@3.0.0 (@ethersproject/json-wallets' AES-128-CTR for Ethereum keystore files, Web3 Secret Storage v3, KDF scrypt/PBKDF2). The dep_scan location is file-level, so this object anchors every AES declaration in package-l

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: XSalsa20-Poly1305 (nacl.secretbox / nacl.box) authenticated-encryption capability of the tweetnacl@0.14.5 dependency (LIB-0469707e). Symmetric AE — quantum-resistant in the standard sense; rating A+. Lockfile/dependency presence only; no application call site in this repo's own source.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: tweetnacl is a declared dependency in package-lock.json (v0.14.5, pulled in via sshpk/http-signature in the react-scripts request chain). The build ships its implementations: Ed25519 signatures, X25519 key agreement, XSalsa20-Poly1305 AE, SHA-512. No application call site found in this repo's own source — presence is what this inventory records.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: node-forge is a declared dependency in package-lock.json (v0.10.0, pulled in via react-scripts / webpack tooling). The build ships its implementations: RSA encryption/signing, X.509 PKI and self-signed cert generation, TLS. No application call site found in this repo's own source — presence is what this inventory records. Related ALG objects (RSA via node-forge, X.509, X.509 self-signed) are the algorithm facets of this same dependency.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 self-signed certificate generation via the selfsigned@1.10.14 dependency (built on node-forge). It is what react-scripts uses to mint a throwaway HTTPS certificate for the local dev server (`HTTPS=true yarn start`); its certificates are RSA-keyed and dev-only, never trusted in production. Lockfile/dependency presence only.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X.509 PKI capability of the node-forge@0.10.0 dependency (LIB-fe0eb9a4): certificate/CSR parsing, building and verification, CRL and OCSP objects. The certificate objects themselves carry RSA/ECDSA signatures whose quantum-safety depends on the key algorithm chosen at issuance. Lockfile/dependency presence only; no application call site in this repo's own source.

properties.name: pqs:context

Present in the tree; no first-party call site in the app source (the app defers wallet handling to MetaMask).
